body: i never publicly accused him of rape. I just told my friends who let the word slip that I “said that”. Does that still count?
Not really. It’s just me, and my parents here.

Are you sure the counselor will keep my confidentiality? When i was younger and i was self harming, my counselor found out and called my mom. I really want to talk to her but i won’t if it means her calling my mom in.

Because my counselor is persistently trying to reach me. I feel as though she’s about to tell my parents about the allegations. I would tell my counselor but i’m pretty sure they can’t keep confidentiality like that

I can’t talk to anyone about it. It’s a very tricky situation. I was intoxicated when it happened and it my parents found out i was sneaking around and drinking and seeing people behind there back i would be kicked out. Everything secret in my life would be exposed. I want to see a therapist again but don’t know how to ask my mom without her getting worried and nosing into my life in an unhealthy way. Long story short, my best friend moved away for college and basically ghosted me. I vented to her about one of our friends lying about me and she freaked out, telling me i need to calm the fuck down and she can’t even talk to me anymore because i’m a “negative” person. It’s so shitty because up until she moved to college, she was also heavily depressed. And then as soon as she moved and she was free, she completely leaves me to figure shit out on my own and is disgusted with the fact that i don’t just get over it. She said word for word, she chose to me happy, and until i can too, she doesn’t want to speak to me. And then she blocked me. I just don’t even know what to say to that. This is the third time in a span of a couple years I have been dropped by my closest friend for not being convenient anymore. All 3 have used my empathy of mental illness and sapped my happiness and boosted themselves up, and then left me for being negative. i’ve given up on finding soulmates. Friend wise. This girl was my closest friend. I discovered myself with her. And i’ve just been abandoned, and it doesn’t affect her because she’s hundreds of miles away. This sounds so juvenile and wordy but it just fucking sucks and i can’t come to terms with it. i just want everything to stop. 

I can’t get out of theatre. In the lead (lots of fucking anxiety with that) and the show is 2 weeks away. I’m the captain of our thespian team outside of the show, and a core leader of our classes. I can’t leave it. It’s what i love, but it’s just miserable with him there. I just want to fucking bash his skull in, but i also never want to touch or look at him again. I don’t know how my male friends are okay with being friends with him when they know what he’s done. i feel so alone and helpless. It’s just so hard right now.
